team.name: Inter Faces
team.squadLead: Head coach Marin Samardžić picked eleven projects, each in the position that fits what it is. Open any player for the full scout report.
team.board: STARTING XI · INTER FACES · 4-3-3 · HEAD COACH MARIN SAMARDŽIĆ

e-sljedivost.title: e-Sljedivost
e-sljedivost.about: Croatia's public food traceability portal: scan a product's QR code and follow it back through the supply chain.
e-sljedivost.why: the last line of trust. Croatia's public food traceability portal, where every product record lives on a blockchain.
e-sljedivost.imageAlt: The public e-Sljedivost portal: scan a QR code or enter a product ID

cross-chain-interop.title: Cross-chain interop
cross-chain-interop.about: Cross-chain supply, borrow and flash-loan flows on Puffer UniFi: one intention, signed once, executed on L1 and L2.
cross-chain-interop.why: it links the two halves of the pitch: one signed intention, executed on L1 and L2.
cross-chain-interop.imageAlt: The cross-chain interop app: one intention, both chains, with Supply, Borrow and Flashloan flows

ai-agents.title: 8 AI agents
ai-agents.about: Eight Claude-based engineering agents for code review, security scans, audits and release prep. I designed and built them.
ai-agents.why: they defend the codebase: review, security scans and audits before anything ships.

reneverse.title: ReneVerse
reneverse.about: Smart Ads, an in-game advertising platform. I built the backend and the on-chain side.
reneverse.why: heavy backend: the serverless pipelines and contracts the ads run on.
reneverse.imageAlt: The ReneVerse website promoting Smart Ads for in-game advertising

cryptotoday.title: CryptoToday
cryptotoday.about: A platform where crypto projects get listed by community vote, not paid placement. I built the backend.
cryptotoday.why: the backend that decides what gets listed: votes, deposits and rewards.
cryptotoday.imageAlt: The CryptoToday homepage: community-voted coin listings

puffer-app.title: Puffer app
puffer-app.about: Puffer's liquid restaking app: stake ETH, receive pufETH, and manage vaults and withdrawals.
puffer-app.why: it holds the midfield and the money: the dApp where users stake.
puffer-app.imageAlt: The Puffer staking app: deposit ETH and receive pufETH

playgrnd.title: PLAYGRND
playgrnd.about: A Croatian amateur football platform: fixtures, live results and player stats. I work on frontend, integrations and AI.
playgrnd.why: pace on the flank: a live product with thousands of players every week.
playgrnd.imageAlt: PLAYGRND: today's amateur matches, featured players and platform stats

amo-na-canj.title: Amo na Čanj
amo-na-canj.about: A two-day summer sports festival by the Cetina river. I co-organised it and built the platform behind it.
amo-na-canj.why: box to box: I organised the festival and built the platform that ran it.
amo-na-canj.imageAlt: The Amo na Čanj festival website

puffer-fi.title: puffer.fi
puffer-fi.about: The rebranded puffer.fi site, built from scratch and prerendered for speed and SEO.
puffer-fi.why: the one everyone sees: the public face of the company, built from scratch.

nk-osk-otok.title: NK OSK Otok
nk-osk-otok.about: The full digital home of a Croatian football club, fed by live federation data and built end to end.
nk-osk-otok.why: my most complete product, from data pipeline to design to CMS, run end to end for a real club.
nk-osk-otok.imageAlt: NK OSK Otok match centre: league table head-to-head, live score and match stats

this-portfolio.title: This portfolio
this-portfolio.about: This site: a scroll-driven walk-out into a 3D stadium, with every word prerendered.
this-portfolio.why: the new signing: a 3D stadium you are standing in right now.
this-portfolio.imageAlt: This portfolio: the Inter Faces team sheet beside the 4-3-3 line-up in the floodlit 3D stadium

ap2-agent-payments.title: AP2 agent payments
ap2-agent-payments.summary: Demo of AI agents paying on Puffer UniFi: recurring x402 payments and automated purchasing.

azra-player.title: Azra music player
azra-player.summary: An early web music player for the band Azra, still online.

kavana-quiz.title: Kavana quiz
kavana-quiz.summary: An archive and builder for pub quiz nights.
